resources.string: Add a DeKoi
Get your DeKoi ready
Your DeKoi starts from a memory card that links it to your account. Prepare the card once, then plug your DeKoi in.
Write a card with this phone
You need a USB-C card reader for the memory card.
I prepared a card with DeKoi Setup on a computer
DeKoi Setup shows a square code. Scan it, or type the code under it.
Scan the code
The scanner did not work. Type the code under the square code instead.

Now plug it in
Put the memory card in your DeKoi.
Plug the network cable into your DeKoi and your router.
